div.head: Northu 46
div.ab: Gif hwa Godes lage oððe folclage wirde, gebete hit georne.
Gif hwa Godes lage oððe folclage wirde, gebete hit georne.
Wenn einer Kirchenrecht oder Volkssatzung verletzt, büsse er es ernstlich.
If anyone violates God's law or the people's law, let him atone for it earnestly.
If anyone violates God's law or the secular law, he is to compensate for it eagerly.
If anyone violates the law of God or the law of the people, he is to atone sincerely for that.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: Cf. also VI Atr 50, Northu. 46, 66 (with the proviso below, pp. 396-7)

div.note: Here a new part begins, not only about church matters. Liebermann compares VI Atr 5 and Northu 66 below.
